integrity: The proof is self-contained. The finite tests replay from one standalone standard-library script; no finite computation is used to justify generality.
scientific_limitations: No infinite-frame dynamics, no general nonlinear period classification, and no modal axiomatization. Related older agreement literature may contain equivalent formulations; independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_scope: All nonempty finite Kripke frames; all valuations; affine threshold, exact least eventual operator preperiod and period for branching at most two, and unbounded finite periods.
title: Affine threshold and unbounded non-contingency cycles on binary-successor frames
